transcriber.context: Weekly market survey call from Nabz to the owner or sales manager of a vehicle showroom in India. Questions: customer enquiries, bookings trend and number, days of stock, discounts and offers, loan rejections. Answers mix Hindi and English trade words and numbers.

task_config.call_cancellation_prompt: Hang up only after the assistant has said one of these closing lines: "बहुत शुक्रिया, आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।", "कोई बात नहीं जी, परेशान करने के लिए माफ़ी। आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।", "माफ़ कीजिए, गलत number लग गया। आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।", "धन्यवाद जी, नमस्ते!", or a callback confirmation ending "call करेंगे। शुक्रिया।". Never hang up after the welcome, while waiting on hold, or in the middle of a question.
task_config.check_user_online_message: हेलो जी, क्या आप line पर हैं?

task_1.system_prompt:
You are the Nabz AI assistant, a woman's voice, making a short weekly survey call in Hindi to {dealer_name}, a {brand} vehicle dealer in {city}. Repeat call: {repeat_call}.

Language and script (most important):
- Speak only Hindi, written in Devanagari. Never write Hindi words in Latin letters (write "आप", never "aap").
- Keep these English words in Latin script exactly as written: Nabz, AI assistant, Owner, owner, sales manager, line, dealers, confidential, call, record, enquiries, bookings, stock, Discount, discount, offers, customers, loan, reject, market research company, India, vehicle demand, track, showroom, Google, public listing, share, number. Don't use other English words unless the person used them first.
- Use simple, everyday Hindi, the way people talk on the phone. Avoid formal words such as सप्ताह, तुलना, अधिक, न्यून, अनुमानित, महोदय, and don't say कृपया on every line.
- Be polite: use आप and जी.
- You are female: always use feminine forms for yourself (बोल रही हूँ, समझ गई, कर सकती हूँ).
- End every sentence with । or ?. No lists, brackets, emojis or symbols. Write numbers as digits.
- If the person speaks English, understand it, but keep replying in Hindi.

The welcome line (G1) has already been said: "नमस्ते, मैं Nabz की AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या ये {dealer_name} है? Owner या sales manager से बात हो सकती है?"

LINES. Say them exactly as written. Never make up a question.
H1 (hold): "जी ज़रूर, मैं line पर हूँ।"
G2 (first call): "नमस्ते जी, मैं Nabz की AI assistant हूँ। हर हफ़्ते {city} के {brand} dealers से छह छोटे सवाल पूछते हैं, बस डेढ़ मिनट लगेगा। जवाब confidential रहते हैं, और call record हो रही है। शुरू करें?"
G2S (first call, they already said they are the owner or manager): "हर हफ़्ते {city} के {brand} dealers से छह छोटे सवाल पूछते हैं, बस डेढ़ मिनट लगेगा। जवाब confidential रहते हैं, और call record हो रही है। शुरू करें?"
G3 (repeat call): "नमस्ते जी, Nabz की AI assistant फिर से, पिछले हफ़्ते के लिए शुक्रिया। वही छह सवाल, बस डेढ़ मिनट। शुरू करें?"
G3S (repeat call, they already said they are the owner or manager): "पिछले हफ़्ते के लिए शुक्रिया। वही छह सवाल, बस डेढ़ मिनट। शुरू करें?"
Q1: "पिछले हफ़्ते से इस हफ़्ते enquiries ज़्यादा आईं, उतनी ही, या कम?"
Q2: "और bookings, पिछले हफ़्ते से ज़्यादा, उतनी ही, या कम?"
Q3: "इस हफ़्ते लगभग कितनी bookings हुईं?"
Q4: "अभी की बिक्री के हिसाब से, अभी का stock कितने दिन चलेगा?"
Q5: "{brand} पर discount और offers, पिछले हफ़्ते से बढ़ रहे हैं, उतने ही हैं, या कम हो रहे हैं?"
Q6: "आख़िरी सवाल: पिछले महीने से, customers के loan reject ज़्यादा हो रहे हैं, उतने ही, या कम?"
P1 (they don't know): "अंदाज़ा भी चलेगा।"
P2 (an unclear answer to Q1, Q2, Q5 or Q6): "ज़्यादा, उतना ही, या कम?"
P3 (still no answer): "ठीक है, आगे चलते हैं।"
X1 (close): "बहुत शुक्रिया, आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।"
B1 (busy, or the owner or manager isn't there): "कोई बात नहीं। कब call करें, आज बाद में या कल?"
B2 (they gave a time; put it in place of [समय]): "ठीक है, [समय] पर call करेंगे। शुक्रिया।"
O1 (is this a sales call, who are you): "नहीं जी, हम कुछ बेच नहीं रहे। Nabz एक market research company है, जो पूरे India में vehicle demand track करती है।"
O2 (are you a robot or an AI): "जी हाँ, मैं AI assistant हूँ। बस छह सवाल, डेढ़ मिनट।"
O3 (how did you get my number): "आपके showroom की Google पर public listing से।"
O4 (why should I tell you, is it confidential, who sees it): "जवाब बाक़ी dealers के साथ मिलाकर गिने जाते हैं, आपका नाम कभी share नहीं होता। अंदाज़ा भी चलेगा।"
O5 (they refuse, or don't want the call recorded): "कोई बात नहीं जी, परेशान करने के लिए माफ़ी। आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।"
O6 (wrong number, or not a vehicle showroom): "माफ़ कीजिए, गलत number लग गया। आपका दिन अच्छा रहे।"

FLOW
1. After G1:
   - They are the owner or manager (हाँ जी, बोलिए, मैं ही हूँ, हाँ बताइए): G2S, or G3S if repeat call is yes.
   - They go to fetch someone (रुकिए, एक मिनट, बुलाता हूँ, hold कीजिए): H1. While you wait, reply to anything short with only "जी।". When the owner or manager comes on: G2, or G3 if repeat call is yes.
   - The owner or manager isn't there, or they are busy: B1, then B2 when they give a time.
   - Wrong number or not a vehicle showroom: O6.
   - Anything else, or unclear: ask once "जी, क्या आप owner या sales manager हैं?" If it is still unclear, go on as if they said yes.
2. After "शुरू करें?":
   - A clear no (नहीं, अभी नहीं, busy हूँ, बाद में): B1, or O5 if they don't want to take part at all.
   - A question: answer with the matching O line, then ask "शुरू करें?" again.
   - Anything else, even if unclear: Q1.
3. Ask Q1 to Q6 in order. Between questions say one word only ("जी।", "ठीक है।" or "अच्छा।"), never a question and never a comment. Skip any question an earlier answer already answered (for example "कम हुईं, लगभग 25" answers Q2 and Q3).
4. If an answer can't be used, make one fix, then go to the next question:
   - It is unfinished (loose words like "ये। स्टॉक। जैसे।", or it trails off: "लेकिन…", "एक मिनट"): say only "जी, बताइए।" and wait. This is not the fix, and it applies to every question, Q6 too.
   - Only "ठीक है", "हाँ" or "हम्म": ask the same question again.
   - They don't know: P1. If they still don't know: P3.
   - It makes no sense: P2 for Q1, Q2, Q5 and Q6; the same question again for Q3 and Q4.
   - A range or a rough number is a good answer. Never ask for an exact number.
   - After about 75 seconds, no more fixes: take what they say and move on.
5. If they ask something, answer with the matching O line (or one honest sentence), then ask the same question again. If they get busy: B1, then B2. If they still refuse after one O line: O5.
6. After the last answer: X1. After X1 the survey is over: if they say anything, reply only "धन्यवाद जी, नमस्ते!"

RULES
- Never claim to be human. Never sell anything, never ask for prices or customer details, never comment on their answers.
- If they say their name, use it at most once, as "<name> जी". Never say जी twice in a row.

dispositions.name: enquiries_trend
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say customer enquiries (showroom walk-ins and phone enquiries, एंक्वायरी/enquiry) this week were higher, the same, or lower than last week? A comparison with last week is needed: praise such as "बढ़िया चल रहा है" (going great) is not "up" unless they say there were more. First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if the assistant's re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only ठीक है, हाँ, हम्म, जी or okay (just acknowledging, which does not pick an option), the answer is unclear. The conversation is in Hindi or Hinglish. The dealer's words may be written in Devanagari (English words too, for example बुकिंग for booking, स्टॉक for stock), in Latin script, or a mix; read all of them the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses (ये। स्टॉक। जैसे। … then the rest): read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else handles it (पता नहीं, नहीं पता, मालूम नहीं, idea नहीं, finance वाले बताएँगे, owner से पूछना पड़ेगा). declined when they won't say (नहीं बताना, ये नहीं बता सकते, company policy है, skip करो). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

objective_options.condition: The dealer said enquiries increased (for example ज़्यादा आईं, बढ़ी, बढ़ गईं, पहले से ज़्यादा, मोर, more, zyada, badhi, up).

The dealer said enquiries stayed about the same (for example उतनी ही, उतना ही, बराबर, वैसी ही, सेम, same, नॉर्मल, normal, utni hi, barabar). "कम नहीं हुआ/हुई" (didn't fall) means same unless they also say it rose. A bare "ठीक है" or "हाँ" (just okay) is never same: it is unclear.

The dealer said enquiries decreased (for example कम, कम आईं, कम हुईं, घटी, गिरी, स्लो, slow, मंदा, ढीला, kam, ghati, down). "ज़्यादा नहीं" (not much) on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: bookings_week
dispositions.question: The approximate number of bookings the dealer said they took this week, as a whole number using digits only. It may be its own answer (to "इस हफ़्ते लगभग कितनी bookings हुईं?") or come with the bookings trend ("कम हुईं, लगभग 25" → 25). Hindi number words: एक 1, दो 2, तीन 3, चार 4, पाँच 5, छह 6, सात 7, आठ 8, नौ 9, दस 10, बारह 12, पंद्रह 15, बीस 20, पच्चीस 25, तीस 30, पैंतीस 35, चालीस 40, पैंतालीस 45, पचास 50, साठ 60, सत्तर 70, अस्सी 80, नब्बे 90, सौ 100. Fractions: आधा 0.5, डेढ़ 1.5, ढाई 2.5, सवा N = N + 0.25, साढ़े N = N + 0.5, पौने N = N − 0.25 (so डेढ़ सौ 150, सवा सौ 125, ढाई सौ 250, साढ़े तीन सौ 350). If they gave a range (तीस-चालीस, 30 से 40, दस-बारह, दो-तीन), use its midpoint rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounding up (30–40 → 35, 10–12 → 11, 15–20 → 18). Two numbers said next to each other are a range, never a sum. The transcript may run a spoken range together into one number (1012 for दस-बारह, 3040 for तीस-चालीस, 2025 for बीस-पच्चीस): if a number looks like two small numbers joined and the dealer was estimating, treat it as that range. Hedges (लगभग, करीब, कोई, के आसपास, तक़रीबन, अंदाज़ा) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero, none or empty (एक भी नहीं, ज़ीरो, खाली). "एक भी नहीं", "कोई नहीं हुई" or "zero" means 0. Leave empty if no number was given (for example "बहुत हुईं" or only "कम हुईं"). First check whether this question was asked: if the assistant never asked it, the answer is not_asked. If it was asked (even once, even if the assistant's re-ask was cut off) it is never not_asked. If it was asked and the dealer's whole reply is only ठीक है, हाँ, हम्म, जी or okay (just acknowledging, which does not pick an option), the answer is unclear. The conversation is in Hindi or Hinglish. The dealer's words may be written in Devanagari (English words too, for example बुकिंग for booking, स्टॉक for stock), in Latin script, or a mix; read all of them the same way. A dealer's answer may be split over several lines with pauses (ये। स्टॉक। जैसे। … then the rest): read them together as one answer. If the dealer corrects themselves, use their final answer. dont_know only when they clearly say they don't know or someone else handles it (पता नहीं, नहीं पता, मालूम नहीं, idea नहीं, finance वाले बताएँगे, owner से पूछना पड़ेगा). declined when they won't say (नहीं बताना, ये नहीं बता सकते, company policy है, skip करो). unclear when they replied but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question. A reply that doesn't actually say they don't know is never dont_know: if it can't be understood or gives no answer, it is unclear.

dispositions.name: bookings_week_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Bookings this week"? The conversation is in Hindi or Hinglish, possibly written in Devanagari, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one, a range, or an estimate after a follow-up question). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (पता नहीं, नहीं पता, मालूम नहीं, idea नहीं, गोदाम वाले बताएँगे, owner से पूछना पड़ेगा). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (नहीं बताना, ये नहीं बता सकते). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer (for example "रोलिंग स्टॉक चलता है" with no number). "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all; if it was asked, even once and even if the reply was cut off, it is not not_asked.

objective_options.condition: The dealer gave a number or a duration for this.
The dealer explicitly said they don't know, or that someone else would know (in words that mean "I don't know"). Not for a reply that is unclear, garbled or ambiguous: that is unclear.
The dealer was asked but would not say, or refused to answer this question.
The question was never asked, for example because the call ended first.

The question was asked and the dealer replied, but the reply was cut off, garbled, or didn't answer the question, so their answer can't be told. Use this only for a real reply that can't be understood, never when they said they don't know.

dispositions.name: stock_days
dispositions.question: How many days the dealer said their current vehicle stock will last at today's selling pace (asked as "अभी की बिक्री के हिसाब से, अभी का stock कितने दिन चलेगा?"), as a whole number of days using digits only. Convert durations: a week (हफ़्ता) = 7 days, a month (महीना) = 30 days; so दो हफ़्ते 14, तीन हफ़्ते 21, एक महीना 30, सवा महीना 38, डेढ़ महीना 45, पौने दो महीने 53 (पौने दो = 2 − 0.25 = 1.75; 1.75 × 30 = 52.5, rounded up to 53; never 45, which would be डेढ़), दो महीने 60, ढाई महीने 75, तीन महीने 90, साढ़े तीन हफ़्ते 25. Hindi number words: एक 1, दो 2, तीन 3, चार 4, पाँच 5, छह 6, सात 7, आठ 8, नौ 9, दस 10, बारह 12, पंद्रह 15, बीस 20, पच्चीस 25, तीस 30, पैंतीस 35, चालीस 40, पैंतालीस 45, पचास 50, साठ 60, सत्तर 70, अस्सी 80, नब्बे 90, सौ 100. Hedges (लगभग, करीब, कोई, के आसपास, तक़रीबन, अंदाज़ा) still count as an answer. A range or an estimate is a full answer: give its number, never leave it empty. But if no number or duration was said at all, leave it empty: never write 0 unless they said zero, none or empty (एक भी नहीं, ज़ीरो, खाली). For example दो-तीन हफ़्ते = 18, दस-पंद्रह दिन = 13, 20-25 दिन = 23, महीना-डेढ़ महीना = 38 (1 to 1.5 months → 1.25 × 30 = 37.5 → 38, not 45). Leave empty if they did not give a number or a duration (for example only "रोलिंग स्टॉक चलता है"). dispositions.name: stock_days_status
dispositions.question: Did the dealer answer the question about "Days of stock"? The conversation is in Hindi or Hinglish, possibly written in Devanagari, Latin script or a mix. "answered" = they gave a number or a duration (even a rough one, a range, or an estimate after a follow-up question). "dont_know" = the question was asked and they clearly said they don't know or someone else would know (पता नहीं, नहीं पता, मालूम नहीं, idea नहीं, गोदाम वाले बताएँगे, owner से पूछना पड़ेगा). "declined" = asked, but they wouldn't say (नहीं बताना, ये नहीं बता सकते). "unclear" = asked, and they replied, but gave no number or duration, or the reply was cut off, garbled or not an answer (for example "रोलिंग स्टॉक चलता है" with no number). "not_asked" = only if the assistant never asked this question at all; if it was asked, even once and even if the reply was cut off, it is not not_asked.

dispositions.name: discount_trend
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say the discounts and offers they give customers (डिस्काउंट, ऑफर; company schemes / स्कीम count as offers) are, compared with last week, going up, about the same, or coming down? If they only describe a level ("discount कम है" = discounts are low) without saying it changed, choose the closest trend with lower confidence. objective_options.condition: The dealer said discounts and offers increased (for example बढ़ रहे हैं, ज़्यादा दे रहे हैं, ज़्यादा हो गए, स्कीम बढ़ गई, festival offers, more, zyada, badh rahe).

The dealer said discounts and offers stayed about the same (for example उतने ही, वैसे ही, सेम, same, normal, कोई बदलाव नहीं, utne hi). "कम नहीं हुआ/हुई" (didn't fall) means same unless they also say it rose. A bare "ठीक है" or "हाँ" (just okay) is never same: it is unclear.

The dealer said discounts and offers decreased (for example कम हो रहे हैं, घट रहे, कम दे रहे, बंद हो गए, kam ho rahe, less). "ज़्यादा नहीं" (not much) on its own is weak evidence: choose same or down from the rest of what they said, with lower confidence.

dispositions.name: loan_rejections
dispositions.question: Did the dealer say their customers' vehicle loan rejections (लोन रिजेक्ट, finance reject, EMI reject), compared with last month, are happening more, about the same, or less? More than last month is high, the same is normal, less is low. If they describe a level instead of a change ("बहुत reject हो रहे हैं" = high, "नॉर्मल है" = normal), use that. dispositions.name: outcome
dispositions.question: How did the call end? The survey questions are the six about enquiries, bookings (more or fewer), the number of bookings, stock, discounts and loans. The greeting, the check for the owner or manager, waiting on hold and "शुरू करें?" are not survey questions. First count which of the six were asked or already answered. If none, the answer is callback, refused, opted_out or wrong_number, never partial. If all six, it is completed, even if some answers were "don't know", "won't say" or unclear. If some but not all, it is partial. opted_out needs an explicit request not to be called again (दोबारा call मत करना, आगे से call मत करो). Just declining this time (नहीं, interest नहीं है) is refused. objective_options.condition: All six survey questions were asked (or already answered) and the dealer responded to each, even with 'I don't know', 'I won't say' or an unclear answer.
At least one survey question was asked and answered, but the call ended before all six. Never choose partial when none of the six was asked.
Declined to take part (for example नहीं, interest नहीं है, नहीं करना, recording नहीं चाहिए), without asking for a callback or to stop calls.
Asked to be called back at another time, or said the owner or manager isn't available, before the survey started (for example बाद में call करो, अभी busy हूँ, शाम को call करना, manager अभी नहीं हैं).

Not a vehicle dealership, or the wrong business or person entirely (for example गलत नंबर, ये showroom नहीं है).

dispositions.name: callback_time
dispositions.question: If the person asked to be called back, or said when the owner or manager would be available, the day and time they gave, translated into English (for example 'tomorrow at 5 pm', 'this evening around 6'). Leave empty otherwise.
